responsibility: Alternative GNAT traceback collector that implements __gnat_backtrace directly on top of GCC’s exception-unwinding tables. For zero-cost-exception configurations it drives _Unwind_Backtrace with a small state structure and callback that fetch program counters, skips requested leading frames, filters out an excluded PC range, applies the target PC adjustment, and fills the caller’s traceback array; for SJLJ exception builds it returns no frames because unwind tables are unavailable. This makes the file the GCC-unwinder-backed traceback variant, complementary to the more general multi-strategy logic in tracebak.c.
